title: Men from a twin-study institute try to take the twins

tellings.quote: And shortly after that, these two guys showed up at our house and they wanted to talk to my father and mother. And they claimed that they were from some >> institute >> institute somewhere that was studying twins and they wanted to take Jack and I away to study us.

plain: Sometime around 1957 to 1959, near Allentown, Pennsylvania, two men came to the Weiner family home and asked to speak with the parents. They said they were from an institute that studied twins and wanted to take the twin boys, Jim and Jack Weiner, away to study them. Jim Weiner, who later says he was abducted by aliens, tells Michels this from memory, as an early sign that someone was interested in the brothers.
